facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission says it and the Department of E-Government are implementing the PPP Connectivity initiative under the Digital Malawi Project for the next ten years, to give over 500 public institutions internet over optic fibre, District Commissioners' offices named among them; the page is undated and the date is its published date.
facts.system: PPP Connectivity initiative / Government Wide Area Network (GWAN)

facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission says the PPP Connectivity initiative, which is to serve District Commissioners' offices among other public institutions, is implemented by the Commission with the Ministry of Information and Digitalization's Department of E-Government, which controls access to the BOMA network through staff numbers or government email; the page is undated and the date is its published date.
facts.system: PPP Connectivity initiative / Government Wide Area Network (GWAN)

facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission says the PPP Connectivity initiative is funded by the World Bank under the Digital Malawi Project, which was to close in June 2024; the page is undated and the date is its published date.
facts.system: PPP Connectivity initiative / Government Wide Area Network (GWAN)

systems.system: PPP Connectivity initiative / Government Wide Area Network (GWAN)
systems.country_label: PPP Connectivity Initiative; GWAN; BOMA, NZIKA and GUEST networks
systems.platform: optic fibre; three segmented networks (BOMA for civil servants, NZIKA for all users, GUEST for visitors)
systems.owner: Public Private Partnership Commission with the Department of E-Government, Ministry of Information and Digitalization; World Bank funding
systems.tiers: over 500 public institutions planned, including District Commissioners' offices and health, education and agriculture institutions; in Mwanza installation still awaited
all civil servants, as the key to the BOMA network and GWAN services

note: The connection of District Commissioners' offices is stated as the initiative's aim, and Mwanza's own systems analyst asks for installation in the district to be speeded up, so no office is said to be connected: a connection announced, recorded as governance only. Sensitisation meetings in all district councils are stated, with no count connected.
